_comment: FABRICATED sample data for the generated documentation examples.
These hosts, versions and findings are invented illustrations -- they are
not captured from any real engagement, and must never be replaced with
real target data. scripts/generate_doc_examples.py feeds this through the
program's real renderers so the README shows exactly what an operator sees.
Because the values here are already placeholders, there is nothing to mask
at render time -- the input IS the masked data.
